cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5)
project(bladerf_pysdrlib C)

# libbladeRF (bladeRF 1.0 and 2.0 micro) built from pysdrlib's trimmed snapshot (see PROVENANCE), without upstream's
# utilities, FPGA tools, documentation or tests. This is tools/vendor/bladerf/CMakeLists.txt, copied here by
# tools/vendor.py: it does what upstream's host/CMakeLists.txt does for libbladeRF and nothing else; edit it there.

set(H ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/host)
if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
    set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()
set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/output)
set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/output)
set(CMAKE_HELPERS_BINARY_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/cmake/helpers)
set(CMAKE_HELPERS_SOURCE_DIR ${H}/cmake/helpers)
list(APPEND CMAKE_MODULE_PATH ${H}/cmake/modules)

set(BLADERF_FW_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/firmware_common)
set(BLADERF_FPGA_COMMON_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fpga_common)
set(BLADERF_FPGA_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIR ${BLADERF_FPGA_COMMON_DIR}/include)
set(BLADERF_FPGA_COMMON_SOURCE_DIR ${BLADERF_FPGA_COMMON_DIR}/src)
set(BLADERF_HOST_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIRS ${H}/common/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/common/include)
set(BLADERF_HOST_COMMON_SOURCE_DIR ${H}/common/src)

option(ENABLE_LOG_FILE_INFO "Enable source file and line number information in log messages." ON)
option(BUILD_DOCUMENTATION "" OFF)
# Upstream's default is ON; other compilers than the ones upstream tests with warn about things that are fine
option(TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS "" OFF)
if(ENABLE_LOG_FILE_INFO)
    add_definitions(-DLOG_INCLUDE_FILE_INFO)
endif()

include(TestBigEndian)
TEST_BIG_ENDIAN(BLADERF_BIG_ENDIAN)
include(FindLibUSB)
if(WIN32)
    include(FindCyAPI)
endif()
include(CheckLibraryExists)
check_library_exists(c clock_gettime "time.h" HAVE_CLOCK_GETTIME)

option(BUILD_AD936X "Include support for the Analog Devices AD936x RFIC (the bladeRF 2.0 micro)." ON)
option(BUILD_AD936X_DEBUG "" OFF)
# upstream's ad936x folder is referenced by path (it expects to sit in host/common/thirdparty/ad936x)
# host_config.h is generated into the build tree; upstream's ad936x guesses its location from the binary dir layout
include_directories(${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/common/include)
add_subdirectory(${H}/common/thirdparty/ad936x ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/host/common/thirdparty/ad936x)

if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "GNU" OR CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
    add_definitions(-Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter)
    if(TREAT_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS)
        add_definitions(-Werror)
    endif()
endif()
if(MSVC)
    add_definitions(-DHAVE_STRUCT_TIMESPEC -D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    if(MSVC_VERSION LESS 1800)
        set(MSVC_C99_INCLUDES ${H}/common/include/windows/c99)
    endif()
endif()

if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Linux")
    set(BLADERF_OS_LINUX 1)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "FreeBSD")
    set(BLADERF_OS_FREEBSD 1)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Darwin")
    set(BLADERF_OS_OSX 1)
    list(APPEND BLADERF_HOST_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIRS ${H}/common/include/osx)
elseif(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME MATCHES "Windows")
    set(BLADERF_OS_WINDOWS 1)
    list(APPEND BLADERF_HOST_COMMON_INCLUDE_DIRS ${H}/common/include/windows)
else()
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unsupported host operating system: ${CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME}")
endif()
configure_file(${H}/common/include/host_config.h.in ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/common/include/host_config.h @ONLY)

set(VERSION_INFO_OVERRIDE "pysdrlib")
add_subdirectory(${H}/libraries/libbladeRF ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/host/libraries/libbladeRF)
